seating.notes: Seat Aino-Kaarina directly next to Päivikki, with clear sightlines and access to the ceremony microphone.

menu.dish: Roasted tomato and seasonal vegetable salad
Herb-roasted chicken with potatoes and seasonal vegetables
Grilled chicken with potatoes and seasonal vegetables
Vanilla cake with seasonal fruit; no almond flour or nut ingredients

photographer: Photographer to be booked; do not book Lumière Fotografia
venue_notes: Arrange a microphone for Finnish interpreter Päivikki Järvenpää; the ceremony will be in Spanish and Finnish.
No nuts in any food, including the cake; confirm ingredients and cross-contact controls with the caterer because a guest has a severe allergy and carries an EpiPen.
Provide meals for 11 vegetarians and 4 children.
Tell the quinta that Pimienta, the couple’s dog, will attend as ring bearer.
If the forecast is over 32°C, move cocktails from the olive grove to the wine cellar.
If costs are tight, cut fireworks before the interpreter; keep all costs within the €42,000 hard budget.
If the ceremony starts late, shorten cocktails rather than the ceremony.
